name: tabcomplete
description: AI-powered inline code completions using the Anthropic API

enumDescriptions: Claude Haiku 4.5 — fastest, lowest cost, best for inline completions
Claude Sonnet 4.6 — balanced speed and quality
Claude Opus 4.7 — highest quality, slower and more expensive
tabComplete.model.description: The Claude model to use for completions.

tabComplete.debounceDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before triggering a suggestion.

tabComplete.maxPromptTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to use for the prompt context (prefix + suffix combined).

tabComplete.prefixPercentage.description: Fraction of maxPromptTokens to allocate to the code before the cursor (prefix).

tabComplete.maxSuffixPercentage.description: Maximum fraction of maxPromptTokens to allocate to the code after the cursor (suffix).

tabComplete.maxCompletionTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate for each completion.

tabComplete.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0 = deterministic, higher = more creative.

tabComplete.useCache.description: Cache completions to avoid duplicate API calls for identical context.

tabComplete.multilineCompletion.description: Allow multi-line completions. When false, completions stop at the first newline.

tabComplete.minTriggerLength.description: Minimum number of characters on the current line before auto-triggering.

tabComplete.modelTimeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds before cancelling a completion.

tabComplete.stopSequences.description: Custom stop sequences. The model stops generating when it produces any of these strings.

tabComplete.enabledLanguages.description: Language IDs to enable completions for. Leave empty to enable for all languages. Example: ["typescript", "python"]

tabComplete.showLoadingIndicator.description: Show a loading spinner in the status bar while a completion is being fetched.
